spec.caption:
Five directory cities with site safety ratings >=8/10 and estimated costs <=USD 1,500/month, ordered by cost.

Safety is a site rating, not an official crime index. Broadband is a 2026 Q1 snapshot.

1. Chiang Mai, Thailand: site safety 8/10; estimated USD 900/month, including USD 350 rent and USD 120 coworking.

2026 Q1 broadband snapshot: 335.9 down / 274.1 up Mbps.

2. Bansko, Bulgaria: site safety 8/10; estimated USD 1,000/month, including USD 380 rent and USD 150 coworking.

2026 Q1 broadband snapshot: 122.4 down / 89.2 up Mbps.

3. Krakow, Poland: site safety 8/10; estimated USD 1,400/month, including USD 550 rent and USD 200 coworking.

2026 Q1 broadband snapshot: 317.2 down / 129.5 up Mbps.

4. Vilnius, Lithuania: site safety 8/10; USD 1,400/month estimated.

2026 Q1 broadband snapshot: 304.7 down / 255.4 up Mbps. Same budget as Krakow; upload is 125.9 Mbps higher.

5. Tallinn, Estonia: site safety 8.2/10; estimated USD 1,500/month, including USD 600 rent, at the budget ceiling.

2026 Q1 broadband snapshot: 183.2 down / 149.7 up Mbps.

Full resource: hashtagweb3.com/nomads/li
